BFCToken suffered from a flash loan attack, resulting in losses of ~$38k. BSC: 0x595eac4a0ce9b7175a99094680fbe55a774b5464. The attacker was able to burn BFCTokens from the pool at no expense by exploiting the "_transfer" function.
